name: DCWL Saturday Night Extreme

date.source: The posts' own subject lines and posting dates (7-8 June 1997).

matches.note: An open challenge issued live by the champion; the surviving capture splits the match across this post and its own follow-up (msg_id J8WUZbJ4UpUJ), which the transmission itself marks "To be Continued." Won via pinfall at 31:01; Tazmanian Crippler retains the Television Championship.
Billed "one half of the Elemental Force" against "one half of Damnation." Won via submission at 19:56.

For the DCWL Unified Heavyweight Championship. Stagg publicly vacates the title and hands it to El Juapo before the bell; a token, pre-arranged pinfall follows at 0:11. An undercard Austin 4:15/Kensuki Kwan match and a post-match faction brawl ("the Independent Nation") on the same broadcast are preserved in the served page text but not separately structured here.

notes: Survives as two consecutive Usenet posts (msg_id tEDUepVyyAMJ, 8 June 1997, and its own follow-up msg_id J8WUZbJ4UpUJ, same date), both served; the second picks the Crippler/Bon Scott open challenge up mid-match where the first breaks off. An earlier Austin 4:15/Kensuki Kwan match and a backstage interview with Bon Scott are preserved in the served text of the first post but are not separately structured into matches[].
